title: Light Weight
text: Light Weight. I recently repainted my bedroom. I wanted some new fresh decor, so I ordered these. It's a set of 3 metal pieces. They are very light weight. The sizes are a little larger than I expected. My husband just used one nail per piece to hang them. They look nice and I am pleased with how they look on my wall.

description: Line your walls with our Madison Park Textured Feather 3-piece Metal Disc Wall Decor Set. Painted with a beautiful blue hued iron finish, this wall decor set offers a splash of color to any room. The feather cutout design is made of a 100% metal material and features attached hook rings on each piece to easily mount on your wall. Available in a set of three, this alternative metal wall decor can be hung together to bring life to any bare wall or hang separately for a little pop throughout your room or home.
